Hi team — copying the AP intake rules here so we can give Gravwell a single, actionable response. TL;DR: portal is preferred and supports multi-PO PDFs if a mapping CSV accompanies the PDF; email fallback is supported but needs a subject token. Details: 

1) Portal behavior (preferred)
- Yes, the portal accepts a single PDF containing multiple invoice sections tied to different POs. Our ingestion engine will try to auto-extract PO numbers from the PDF, but accuracy improves if you upload a compact CSV mapping file in the same submission.
- CSV expectations (attached example compact_csv_example.csv): one row per line-item mapping, columns = invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, total_line_amount. Use UTF-8, comma-delimited, no header row required (we tolerate headers but remove them in ingestion).
- If you prefer a single-line summary per PO instead of per-line-item, include an additional column summary_flag=TRUE and our parser will create aggregated ledger rows.

2) Email fallback (ap-invoices@redwood.com)
- If you must email, subject must include XREF token in this format: INV|<vendor_invoice_number>|PO1,PO2,... Example: INV|GW-0427-01|PO-9982,PO-9983. The ingestion mailbox reads tokens from the subject to prioritize matching. 
- If the subject token is missing, the message is routed to manual triage and will incur longer SLA (2–3 business days).

3) Cut-off and SLA
- Portal timestamp cutoff for month-end posting: 23:59 PST on month-end. For email fallback the cutoff is 20:00 PST (to allow manual triage before run). Anything after will be processed next run.
- Portal acknowledgements: immediate ack token in subject and PDF metadata (ack token sample included in portal_integration_notes.md). Email fallback gets an automated receipt but no matching ack token unless the subject token is used.

4) VAT / tax and remittance
- Include explicit tax columns in the CSV (tax_amount) and the remittance address as a separate field in the invoice PDF or as remittance_address column in the CSV. If Gravwell is VAT-registered, include VAT ID in the invoice header.

Attachments: compact_csv_example.csv, portal_integration_notes.md

Action for Jasmine: please send the compact CSV template and the token format to Gravwell and offer a quick portal demo if they'd like to test a sandbox upload.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
